bundles.evidenceText: I think that that's one that I think fits quite nicely within my worldview as well. You know we are all currently you know submitting to a certain idea of what we're going to do.
bundles.rationale: The excerpt proposes that people jointly submit to a shared idea of what they will do and that this example fits Folley's worldview. This supports the subsidiary claim that collective purpose and constraint can arise through human coordination and social practices. That narrow bridge is preferable to the central bridge, because the excerpt does not generally characterize patterns and values as useful mind-grounded abstractions, and it does not establish the complete motion-level conclusion.

bundles.rationale: The excerpt proposes that resurrection became convincing through its experienced meaning, downstream consequences, and disclosed portrait of the world, thereby supporting the subsidiary symbolic-meaning bridge apart from isolated historical attestation. The central Logos bridge is the nearest competitor but is excluded because no upward inference from purposive patterns to Logos is asserted; the complete motion conclusion is likewise unstated.
